notes: JAVA_HOME can point to any independently installed compatible Java 21 distribution; IntelliJ IDEA is not a product dependency.
Java 24 started the database but produced an unsupported-runtime warning; only the subsequent Java 21 run is the supported-version evidence.
The adapter uses CGC's Neo4j DatabaseManager and PLC-specific Cypher. Generic CGC ST parsing and the CGC MCP server are not claimed.
The minimal isolated adapter installation intentionally omits unused CGC CLI, generic parsers and other graph backends. Use the complete cgc extra when those upstream components are needed.
